normal.name: Millie(let)
normal.text: I am an indecisive BLFC creature right now. Do we wanna all chill in a room? Or go to closing ceremonies? Or go play old PC games in za games room again? Decisions decisions

normal.name: 🦇🔪 🩸  Spookya
normal.text: I have spent two weeks drawing fish found in La Jolla. for merch? no to make an educational video game about marine bio because nostalgia hit me like a brick about how games used to be informative. Like any of the math/reading blaster, clue finders, atlas obscura games.

normal.name: Mentoch
normal.text: Can anyone recommend me new video games to play? My video card is fried, so gotta be retro graphics level. I want platformers, rogue-likes, JRPGs, etc. I want modern SNES style gaming.

normal.name: CyNetrunner
normal.text: You don't understand. I WILL push through a game on normal difficulty even if it's frustrating so I can reach the end as the devs intended, but be better able to voice my criticism. And for old games, add to my experience of seeing how good we have it nowadays. 😌

normal.name: Corey_V_Assistant (or Vice'sAssistant) VT
normal.text: The XP one I would like to try and figure out how to stream from to play old games. As for the bigger one, depending how it is, I would like to see if maybe I can use it as either a PC for streaming, or my main PC, if it could run the stuff I want.

normal.name: Princess Amber
normal.text: I just found out my favorite mobile game from my childhood is on steam!!!! The game was taken down years ago off the appstore but it still lives on steam. Legit perfect for my steam deck

normal.name: Archsage
normal.text: OoT Remake for all the hype and it's looks just will not make the sales figures that BoTW did. The scale of nostalgia bros to today's current video game modern audience is so far apart it's hilarious. That is what will dictate the sales. Not loyalty and dedication.

normal.name: Matted with Satsy
normal.text: Alright the android device is set up for retro games, Gamecube, some Android specific games, and a whole pile of Steam games are downloaded. This should NOT have been done at 1am but it's all good! Still can't decide what to do with the old ORAS save though. TOMORROW THOUGHTS!

normal.name: Veronica R.A. Le'Peltér Esq.🌹₊˚🪻
normal.text: Gaming is actually a ridiculously affordable hobby, especially if you can buy a gaming PC off a friend, get a laptop on sale, or I suppose buy a console. Maybe play retro games with an old system gotten off an older relative. I, as a rule, prefer higher quality products that cost more.

normal.name: JeЯemy Complains
normal.text: I'm enjoying it so far but man does it take a while to get going. I miss the old games being like "happy 12th birthday! Here's a dangerous animal that could easily kill you. Now go explore the world unsupervised. Good luck!"

normal.name: Danny Korcz
normal.text: Regardless of what anyone thinks about The Nostalgia Critic and Angry Video Game Nerd, I think they ended up doing more harm than good for the YouTube critic scene given how many anti-woke knockoffs there are of them. Looking at you, The Critical Drinker and The Second Story.
normal.media: quotes @agramuglia.bsky.social: I sometimes wonder if some YouTube critics even like movies.

normal.name: Zonino
normal.text: Saw a discussion on Reddit saying that unlike video games, old movies or books which aren't good just disappear from the cultural zeitgeist and buddy... buddy c'mon. Games suffer the same fate. You aren't seriously telling me people are out there championing Super Troll Islands?
